arithmetic: exact rational times, exact finite cylinder enumeration

negative_controls.name: fast_ray_without_recovery_guards
negative_controls.outcome: Every finite prefix has arbitrarily deep cumulative infection and no infection at the limit horizon; the proof explicitly rules this out.

negative_controls.name: selecting_with_recovery_data
negative_controls.outcome: The selected recovery-free bit is biased to probability one; the candidate selection never reads recovery data.

negative_controls.name: allowing_zero_offspring
negative_controls.outcome: A supercritical law can have nonzero extinction probability and a nonzero hereditary bad fixed point; ξ≥1 is essential for the candidate unconditional almost-sure conclusion.

scope: Finite path witnesses, orientation, recovery endpoints, finite-volume monotonicity, adaptive unused-field independence, and boundary counterexamples. These controls cannot certify infinite limits or the theorem; the accompanying report supplies those deductions.
